confirmed.statement: S1 has 230 MTurk annotators: 142 US and 88 Indian people. Table 2 distinguishes annotators from annotated comments and annotations.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 7, Section 3.1, Validating Argumentation Style; p. 9, Table 2 (checked with PyMuPDF table extraction).

confirmed.statement: S1 regenerates comments with incorrect or insufficiently agreed labels; it does not report excluding people. Randomization-stage and style-specific people counts are not supplied, consistent with the null fields.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 7-9, Section 3.1, validation procedure and Table 2.

confirmed.statement: S2 has 49 pilot participants, calculated as the explicitly reported 27 US plus 22 Indian participants whose explanations informed the survey. Its allocation method, recruitment platform and exclusions are not stated.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 10, Section 3.1, paragraph immediately below Table 4.

confirmed.statement: S3 reports 103 participants (51 US, 52 India) and four attention-check exclusions, leaving 99 people. Table 4 independently gives 50 US plus 49 Indian participants.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 9, Experiment 1: Capturing Perceptions of Constructiveness; p. 10, Table 4 and final paragraph of Section 3.1.

confirmed.statement: Logical and dialectical comments in S1 and S3 are randomly selected rating stimuli, not separate groups of writers assigned AI assistance. No disjoint style-specific participant totals are reported.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 7-10, Section 3.1, validation and perception-experiment procedures.

confirmed.statement: S4 explicitly randomizes individual participants between independent writing and GPT-4 assistance. Each participant is asked to write one comment on each of two threads.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 10, Section 3.2, Writing Task and control/test descriptions.

confirmed.statement: S4 reports 103 writers in the Introduction. Table 5 lists 52 US and 51 Indian completers, and the results analyze their final comments; this supports the form's study-level total of 103 people, without establishing every outcome-specific denominator.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 2, final paragraph; p. 12, Table 5 (checked with PyMuPDF table extraction); p. 14, opening of Section 4.2.

confirmed.statement: S4 recruitment reports 52 Indian plus 52 US people, differing by one from Table 5. The reason and timing of that difference are not reported, so the form correctly preserves the discrepancy and leaves the assignment-stage count null.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Participant Recruitment and Table 5; no resolving participant-flow information in Figure 1 (p. 7) or Appendix A (pp. 30-33).

confirmed.statement: S4's 104 control and 102 test observations are explicitly comments, not people. Arm-specific numbers of randomized or analyzed people are not explicitly tabulated; the form leaves them null rather than using these output totals.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Participant Recruitment; p. 14, opening of Section 4.2; p. 10, two-thread writing procedure.

confirmed.statement: The statement that 87 test participants incorporated suggestions concerns the initial-to-final revision comparison. Its people denominator cannot be reconciled with the two-comment task and reported totals; the form already marks it unresolved and does not count 87 as a verified sample.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 16, Section 4.2.2, final two paragraphs; pp. 10 and 12, writing procedure and totals; pp. 32-33, Tables 17-18 supply no clarifying people counts.

confirmed.statement: S5 recruited 82 Indian and 82 US raters and discarded seven attention-check failures, yielding 157 analyzed people. Its 727 evaluations, including 401 HAI/Human, 141 Human/AI and 185 HAI/AI comparisons, are not participant counts.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Human Evaluation of Constructiveness; p. 14, Section 4.2.1.

confirmed.statement: S5's stated four pairs per rater do not reconcile with 727 evaluations from 157 retained raters. The form already flags this output-count inconsistency; 157 is explicitly stated twice and also equals 164 recruits minus seven exclusions.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Human Evaluation of Constructiveness; p. 14, Section 4.2.1; form open_questions records the inconsistency.

confirmed.statement: S4 writers are described as a different set who did not take part in Phase 1. S5 recruitment excludes prior Phase 1 and Phase 2 writing participation; its rating dataset reuses S4 outputs and Phase 1 AI comments, not a new writer sample.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 2, Phase 2 introduction; p. 12, Participant Recruitment and Human Evaluation of Constructiveness; p. 14, opening of Section 4.2.

confirmed.statement: Overlap among the preparatory validation, pilot and perception samples is not specified. No reuse of participants from another paper is disclosed, so external overlap remains unknown rather than proven absent.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 7-10, Phase 1 descriptions; full document including references and Appendix A, pp. 1-33.

confirmed.statement: Figure 1 and Appendix A provide no additional participant-flow or arm-level people counts. S4 alone supports at least 50 analyzed people; the abstract's aggregate 600, annotators, raters and repeated comments are unnecessary for criterion 2.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 7, Figure 1; pp. 30-33, Appendix A; S4 evidence on pp. 2, 10, 12 and 14.

summary: The recorded people totals are supported: S1 230, S2 49, S3 99, S4 103 and S5 157. S4 alone meets the 50-person criterion, while the form already preserves the recruitment discrepancy, ambiguous revision subset and unknown assignment-stage and arm counts.
